acceptanceCriteria: Replay runs the author and draft stages with outward writes recorded rather than performed, with focused tests and independent review.
A labelled historical replay set of merged changes exists with expected outcomes, and its provenance is recorded.
The qualification campaign runs over that set and its results, including mismatches and uncertainty, are recorded; nothing unrun is reported as passed.
body: The owner accepted the delivered scope of #395 on 2026-10-05 and closed it with qualification NOT_RUN; V1-0542 was completed on that basis. Delivered: fixture basis, corvint-postmerge-workflow replay --change --dry-run without credentials, an identical second run and reports split by basis. Not delivered or not run, now tracked here: (1) the author and draft stages of replay are owner-deferred, not delivered; (2) no historical replay set exists; (3) the qualification campaign is NOT_RUN. Recorded in docs/specs/postmerge-replay-v0.md and docs/build-log/2026-10-05-postmerge-issues-accepted-not-run.md.
title: Post-merge replay: author and draft stages, a historical replay set and the qualification campaign (issue #395 follow-up)
